_doc: Englische Texte. Schlüssel = deutscher Originaltext (siehe scripts/core/loc.gd). Platzhalter (%d, %s, %+d, %%) müssen erhalten bleiben. Prüfen: python3 tools/i18n_check.py en
4 Sektoren, je ein Boss am Ausgang. Die: 4 sectors, each with a boss at the exit. The hunter front advances with every jump: after 10 jumps it catches up with you.
Sektor um Sektor, ohne Verfolger. Die Ge: Sector after sector, no pursuers. The enemies keep getting stronger. How far can you go?
Nochmal: alter Run geht verloren: Again: old run will be lost
Sprache der Texte im Spiel: Language of all texts in the game
HD: Schrift in voller Auflösung · Retro:: HD: text at full resolution · Retro: everything on the coarse pixel grid
Wie schnell Zeit an Bord und im Kampf ve: How fast time passes on board and in combat
Kampf hält an, solange Crew oder Waffe a: Combat pauses while crew or a weapon is selected
Bildschirm wackelt bei Treffern und Expl: Screen shakes on hits and explosions
Kämpfe gegen dieses Schiff, um es ins Le: Fight this ship to add it to the codex.
Nimm jemanden dieser Spezies in deine Cr: Take someone of this species into your crew, for example through events or traders.
Alle Türen offen: Luft gleicht sich aus,: All doors open: air evens out, fire can spread
Schleusen öffnet man einzeln: gelbe Luke: Airlocks open one at a time: tap a yellow hatch on the ship
Gegnerraum antippen: alle Waffen zielen: Tap an enemy room: all weapons aim · weapon card, then room: only that weapon
Energie: Spalte antippen +1, gedrückt ha: Power: tap a column +1, hold −1 · hold a weapon card: on/off
Tür oder gelbe Schleuse antippen: auf/zu: Tap a door or yellow airlock: open/close · an open airlock vents the air
Crew antippen, dann Ziel · Wer im Raum s: Tap crew, then a destination · crew in a room fight fires, patch and repair
SPRUNG lädt nach jedem Sprung neu (Pilot: JUMP recharges after every jump (needs a pilot, in combat also engines) · when full: pick a target on the map
Pause antippen (oder Leertaste) · halten: Tap pause (or space) · hold: auto-pause on/off (A)
liefert Energie (Leiste ganz links): supplies power (bar on the far left)
Energie für die Waffen unten rechts: power for the weapons, bottom right
heilt Crew, die im Raum steht: heals crew standing in the room
Das ist dein Frachter. Oben links Hülle: This is your freighter. Top left: hull and shields, next to them fuel and scrap. On the left: your crew.
Tippe eine Figur im Schiff an (oder link: Tap a crew member on the ship (or in the crew list on the left).
Tippe jetzt einen Raum an: Die Figur läu: Now tap a room: the crew member walks there. At a console they operate the system and make it stronger.
Unten links: Spalte antippen gibt +1 Ene: Bottom left: tap a column for +1 power, hold to remove 1. The reactor is never enough for everything.
Türen unten rechts oder direkt im Schiff: Tap doors bottom right or directly on the ship. Open airlocks vent the air and smother fires.
Tippe den Pause-Knopf oben rechts (oder: Tap the pause button top right (or space). While paused you can give orders calmly.
Nochmal antippen, dann läuft die Zeit we: Tap again and time runs on. Holding it toggles auto-pause.
Der Sprungantrieb lädt (Balken bei SPRUN: The jump drive is charging (bar under JUMP). When it is full, tap JUMP. Someone has to sit in the cockpit.
Tippe ein gelbes Ziel an, nochmal antipp: Tap a yellow target, tap again to jump. Every jump costs 1 fuel.
Ein Piratenkutter. Solange dieser Kasten: A pirate cutter. While this box is open, combat is on hold. Your weapons charge at the bottom as soon as they have power.
Tippe einen Raum des Gegners an: Alle Wa: Tap an enemy room: all weapons aim there and fire once charged. Tip: shields first!
Schilde fangen Schüsse ab, deine Crew re: Shields stop shots, your crew repairs damaged rooms. Destroy the cutter!
Du kennst jetzt die Grundlagen. Im Lexik: You now know the basics. The codex lists every ship and species you have discovered. Good luck, captain!
Kein Treibstoff: Notsignal senden: No fuel: send a distress signal
SPRUNG führt in den nächsten Sektor: JUMP takes you to the next sector
Sektor geschafft: SPRUNG führt in den nä: Sector cleared: JUMP takes you to the next sector · BACK to the ship
Sektor geschafft · SPRUNG antippen: weit: Sector cleared · tap JUMP: on to sector %d
Sektor %d · Antrieb lädt · dann SPRUNG a: Sector %d · drive charging · then tap JUMP and pick a target
Die Jäger haben euch eingeholt: %s!: The hunters have caught up with you: %s!
Sprung: Jemand muss ins Cockpit: Jump: someone has to man the cockpit
Kein Treibstoff mehr: Notsignal senden u: Out of fuel: send a distress signal and hope friends answer
Cockpit nicht besetzt: Karte nur ansehen: Cockpit unmanned: view only · BACK to the ship
Antrieb ohne Energie: Karte nur ansehen: Engines unpowered: view only · BACK to the ship
Antrieb lädt noch: Karte nur ansehen · Z: Drive still charging: view only · BACK to the ship
Flucht: Ziel antippen, nochmal antippen: Escape: tap a target, tap again to jump
Gelbes Ziel antippen, nochmal antippen s: Tap a yellow target, tap again to jump · boss at the exit on the right · hunters from the left
Tap a yellow target, tap again to jump
Hier ist das Schiff gerade: The ship is here right now
Zu weit weg: nur direkt verbundene Ziele: Too far: only directly connected targets
Kein Treibstoff für den Sprung: Notsigna: No fuel for the jump: send a distress signal
Sektor %d · neue Karte, die Jäger beginn: Sector %d · new map, the hunters start over
an: Kampf hält beim Auswählen von Crew o: on: combat pauses when you select crew or a weapon
Gegner lädt den Sprungantrieb! Antrieb o: Enemy is charging its jump drive! Hit engines or cockpit
Alle %d Sektoren geschafft!\nDie Jäger h:
All %d sectors cleared!
The hunters are left behind.
Pause: Befehle geben, dann Pause-Knopf o: Paused: give orders, then pause button or space
Waffe %d: Gegnerraum antippen (gleicher: Weapon %d: tap an enemy room (same room = clear target)
Gegnerraum: alle Waffen zielen · Waffenk: Enemy room: all weapons aim · weapon card: one at a time
Noch %d %s · Crew in beschädigte Räume s: %d %s left · send crew to damaged rooms
Antrieb bereit · SPRUNG antippen und Zie: Drive ready · tap JUMP and pick a target
Antrieb lädt · mehr Energie im Antrieb l: Drive charging · more engine power charges faster
· freie Kachel antippen = hinschicken: · tap a free tile = send there
Ein Handelsposten der Gilde. Bezahlt wir: A guild trading post. Payment in scrap or fuel.
Your guild letter gets you a %d %% discount.
[Kolonie] Komplettreparatur auf Kosten d: [Colony] Full repair at the guild's expense
Eine Reparaturstation mit Werftdock. Die: A repair station with a dry dock. The technicians work fast, but not for free.
Die Kolonie hat euch angekündigt: Eine: The colony sent word ahead: one full repair is on the house.
Dank der Kolonie: Gratisreparatur in der: Colony's gratitude: free repair at the repair station
Ein umgebauter Massengutfrachter der Ker: A converted bulk freighter from the core worlds. Plenty of room for crew and future modules, a solid hull, but only a small reactor: if you want to run everything at once, you have to distribute power wisely.
Die Fregatten der Jägerfront verfolgen d: The frigates of the hunter front chase you through every sector. Thick hull, big reactor and three weapons: whoever gets caught fights a ship built for exactly this hunt.
Schnelle Kutter der Randbanden, zusammen: Fast cutters of the rim gangs, welded together from scrap. Thin hull and little room, but with a pulse laser and a cannon they are dangerous to anyone who neglects their shields.
Ein Kutter mit verstärktem Reaktor und z: A cutter with a reinforced reactor and an extra cannon. Seasoned gangs fly it deeper in the sector, and their leaders use it as a flagship at the sector exit.
Die Menschen sind über hundert Systeme v: Humans are scattered across a hundred systems and fly almost anything with a reactor. No strength stands out, no weakness holds them back: anyone who sits at a console for long learns faster than any other species.
Insektoide Jäger aus den Gluthöhlen von: Insectoid hunters from the ember caves of Kith. Their chitin shell withstands heat well, and on six legs they are faster than anyone else on board. Precision mechanics, however, are not their thing at all.
Gebaut für Wartung und Bergbau, inzwisch: Built for maintenance and mining, now free citizens with minds of their own. They need no air, repair faster than any workshop crew and have a knack for shield matrices. Biological healing only works half as well on them.
Medbay heilt nur halb so schnell: Medbay heals only half as fast
Schlanke, feinfühlige Wesen von einem Ga: Slender, sensitive beings from a gas giant's moon. Their senses pick up the faintest energy patterns, which makes them more precise at weapons and sensors. Their bodies, however, are fragile.
Massige Kolonisten von einer Schwerkraft: Hulking colonists from a high-gravity world. An Ormok shrugs off hits that would floor anyone else and blocks entire corridors in a boarding fight. Their paws are too coarse for tools and consoles.
Lebendes Gestein aus der Kruste eines to: Living rock from the crust of a dead planet. Petrani neither breathe nor burn; fire and vacuum mean nothing to them. They move sluggishly, and the medbay cannot heal their mineral bodies. Instead, their stone slowly grows back on its own.
Medbay wirkt nicht, wächst langsam von s: Medbay doesn't work, slowly grows back on its own
Ein ausgebrannter Frachter treibt quer z: A burnt-out freighter drifts across your path. The cargo hatches are open, the emergency lights still flicker.
Im Frachtraum liegen unbeschädigte Ersat: The hold contains undamaged spare parts and two full fuel cells.
Eine Sprengfalle der Piraten geht hoch,: A pirate booby trap goes off as the crew pries open the hatch. They still manage to salvage a few parts.
Die Crew zapft die Resttanks ab. Sicher,: The crew drains what is left in the tanks. Safe, but not much.
Ein schwaches Notsignal: eine einzelne R: A faint distress signal: a single escape pod, its life support in the red.
Eine erschöpfte Technikerin klettert her: An exhausted technician climbs out. She wants to stay and lend a hand.
Die Kapsel ist leer, der Insasse war sch: The pod is empty, its occupant long gone. Its components are still usable.
Ein Köder! Kaum ist die Kapsel an Bord,: A decoy! The moment the pod is aboard, a pirate cutter drops out of a jump.
Forschungsstation auf dem Eismond: Research station on the ice moon
Die Sensoren erfassen eine verlassene Fo: Sensors pick up an abandoned research station on an ice moon. The airlocks are frozen shut, but lights still burn inside.
Das Labor ist voller Geräte, die niemand: The lab is full of equipment nobody will miss. The team hauls it all to the shuttle.
Ein Gang bricht unter dem Eis ein. Das T: A corridor collapses under the ice. The team returns injured, but with loot.
Im Tanklager stehen noch Fässer mit Fusi: The tank farm still holds barrels of fusion fuel.
Die Scans zeigen eine alte Sonde im Orbi: The scans reveal an old probe in orbit. You catch it and strip it for parts.
Der Mond bleibt still hinter euch zurück: The moon falls silent behind you.
Eine kleine Bergbaukolonie funkt um Hilf: A small mining colony is calling for help: its reactor is failing, the heating will only last a few more hours. It belongs to the traders' guild.
Die Kolonisten bekommen den Reaktor wied: The colonists get the reactor back online. The administrator promises to notify the next guild shipyard: they will repair you for free.
Eure Leute flicken den Reaktor. Aus Dank: Your people patch up the reactor. In gratitude, the colony's mechanics overhaul your hull.
Eine Dampfleitung platzt, ein Crewmitgli: A steam line bursts and a crew member gets scalded. The reactor runs anyway, and the colony is grateful.
Ein Frachter der Händlergilde treibt mit: A traders' guild freighter drifts with dead engines. Its captain asks for a jump start from your reactor.
Der Antrieb springt an. Die Kapitänin sc: The engines roar to life. The captain sends her mechanics over and hands you a guild letter: traders will give you better prices from now on.
Starthilfe nur gegen Bezahlung: Jump start for a fee only
Sie zahlt mit Ersatzteilen, aber sie wir: She pays in spare parts, but she will remember you.
The freighter is left behind on its own.
Ein dichtes Asteroidenfeld mit hohem Met: A dense asteroid field with a high metal content. With a little skill you could mine ore here.
The crew fills the hold with ore.
Ein Brocken streift den Rumpf. Das Erz i: A rock grazes the hull. The ore is aboard all the same.
Ein Kutter bremst neben euch ab. Auf all: A cutter pulls up alongside. On all channels: “Transit toll. Pay up, or we'll take it ourselves.”
Die Piraten nehmen die Teile und ziehen: The pirates take the parts and leave.
Weapons charging. The cutter comes about.
Volle Schubkraft: Ihr seid weg, bevor si: Full thrust: you are gone before they can take aim.
Zu langsam. Der Kutter eröffnet das Feue: Too slow. The cutter opens fire.
Ein nervöser Pilot bietet Treibstoff aus: A nervous pilot offers fuel from a dubious source, cheap and no questions asked.
Der Treibstoff ist sauber. Ein guter Han: The fuel is clean. A good deal.
Verunreinigt: Der Tank läuft halb leer,: Contaminated: the tank drains half empty before you notice.
The smuggler vanishes into a jump.
Vor euch tobt ein Ionensturm. Hindurch g: An ion storm rages ahead. Going through is faster, but the discharges take their toll on the hull.
It crackles and bangs, but the hull holds. Wreckage drifts in the storm.
The storm is calmer than feared.
Der Umweg kostet Treibstoff, aber nieman: The detour costs fuel, but nobody gets hurt.
Auf einem Wüstenplaneten steht eine stil: An abandoned mine sits on a desert planet. The conveyor belts are full, the tunnel looks unstable.
Volle Erzloren und ein Tank Brennstoff f: Full ore carts and a tank of fuel for the drills.
Der Stollen gibt nach. Das Team gräbt si: The tunnel gives way. The team digs itself out, injured.
Der Stollen stürzt ein. Nicht alle komme: The tunnel collapses. Not everyone makes it back.
Ein paar Kisten Erz vom Eingang, ohne Ri: A few crates of ore from the entrance, no risk.
The sand covers your landing tracks.
Eine Passagierfähre ist auf einem Dschun: A passenger ferry has crash-landed on a jungle planet. Survivors are broadcasting their position on a loop.
Ihr bringt alle Überlebenden an Bord. Ei: You bring all survivors aboard. One pilot wants to sign on with you, the others pay with what they have.
Die Rettung gelingt, doch die Fauna wehr: The rescue succeeds, but the wildlife fights back. The survivors pay with the ferry's fuel.
Position an die Gilde melden: Report the position to the guild
Die Gilde schickt ein Rettungsschiff und: The guild sends a rescue ship and thanks you with a guild letter.
Eine Frachterkapitänin der Gilde wird vo: A guild freighter captain is being chased by pirates and asks you to cover her.
Ihr stellt euch zwischen Frachter und Ku: You put yourselves between the freighter and the cutter.
Ein kleiner Händler hat euer Notsignal a: A small trader picked up your distress signal. He has fuel, but nothing comes for free.
Er schraubt sich ab, was er brauchen kan: He unbolts whatever he can use. Your hull is thinner afterwards.
Auf euer Notsignal antwortet nicht die G: Your distress signal isn't answered by the guild, but by a pirate cutter with full tanks.
Eine Patrouille der Händlergilde schwenk: A traders' guild patrol turns towards your signal.
Für Freunde der Gilde ist das selbstvers: For friends of the guild that goes without saying: full tanks.
Sie geben euch das Nötigste, mit einem s: They give you the bare minimum, with a stern look.
Waffen der Gilde. Neue Waffen kommen in: Guild weapons. New weapons go into a free weapon slot, otherwise into storage (%d/%d). Weapons sell for half price.
Im Hafen warten Leute auf eine Heuer. Pl: People at the docks are looking for a berth. Room aboard: %d/%d.
Ausbauen kostet Rohstoffe. Namen antippe: Upgrades cost scrap. Tap a name to see what it does.
kaufen und verkaufen beim Händler: buy and sell at a trader
Waffe eingebaut; Energie gibt es über di: Weapon installed; power it via its weapon card
Repariert Systeme langsam auch ohne Crew: Slowly repairs systems even without crew
Feuer wächst und breitet sich halb so sc: Fire grows and spreads half as fast
Jeder Sprung kostet mit 25 % Chance kein: Each jump has a 25 % chance to cost no fuel
Eine Forschungsstation der Gilde hat den: A guild research station has lost contact with its survey probe. The director asks you to recover the data core. The last bearing is a few jumps away.
Die Leiterin überspielt euch die letzte: The director sends you the last bearing. A fuel cell serves as a down payment.
Die Leiterin nickt enttäuscht und schlie: The director nods, disappointed, and closes the channel.
An der Peilung treibt die Sonde, eingesp: The probe drifts at the bearing, wrapped in a web of cables. A scavenger has tapped into it, and his drones swarm around the data core.
Der Schrottsammler will seine Beute nich: The scavenger won't give up his prize and opens fire.
Außenteam schleicht sich an die Sonde: Away team sneaks up to the probe
Eure Leute gleiten im Schatten der Sonde: Your people glide in the probe's shadow and reach the data core unnoticed.
Eine Drohne entdeckt das Außenteam. Ein: A drone spots the away team. A shot grazes a spacesuit, then the scavenger ship opens fire.
Eure Veyari lauscht den Drohnen ihr Funk: Your Veyari listens in on the drones' radio pattern and sends them home. The scavenger notices nothing.
You leave the probe to the scavenger.
Der Kern ist intakt und voller Sternkart: The core is intact and full of star charts. Next to it sits an unopened guild weapons container, apparently part of the probe's cargo.
Kern und Container mitnehmen: Take the core and the container
Die Kartografen zahlen gut für die Daten: The cartographers pay well for the data and write you a guild letter. You may keep the container: a brand-new burst laser.
Nur den Kern abliefern, den Container ve: Deliver only the core, sell the container
Die Kartografen zahlen für die Daten, ei: The cartographers pay for the data, a trader for the container. Together a handsome sum.
Am Schwarzen Brett der Station hängt ein: A wanted poster hangs on the station's notice board: Captain Rask has plundered three guild freighters. An informant at the bar claims to know his hideout.
Der Informant nennt euch das Versteck: e: The informant names the hideout: a hollowed-out asteroid. The guild pays the bounty as soon as you succeed.
You leave the poster where it is.
Im Schatten eines ausgehöhlten Asteroide: A pirate cutter lies at anchor in the shadow of a hollowed-out asteroid. The radio traffic gives it away: Rask is aboard, his crew is moving loot.
Rask lässt die Ladeluken schließen und g: Rask seals the cargo hatches and moves to intercept.
Euer Trupp schafft zwei Kisten an Bord,: Your team gets two crates aboard before the alarm goes off. Rask gives chase.
Ein Wachposten schlägt Alarm. Im Feuerge: A sentry raises the alarm. A crew member is badly wounded in the firefight.
Euer Ormok funkt eine Herausforderung, d: Your Ormok broadcasts a challenge every pirate in the system can hear. Rask can't refuse without losing face.
Eure Kith'ra krabbelt durch die Lüftungs: Your Kith'ra crawls through the cutter's vents and shuts down its reactor. Rask surrenders without a shot, and the loot is yours.
You leave Rask in his hideout.
Rask lacht über die Herausforderung, nim: Rask laughs at the challenge but accepts in front of his crew. On the asteroid's rock, the pirate and your Ormok face each other.
After three blows Rask lies in the dust. His crew surrenders and hands over the loot. The guild pays the full bounty.
Rask kämpft unfair, seine Leute mischen: Rask fights dirty and his crew joins in. Someone from your crew is hurt in the brawl, but in the end Rask is down.
Eine Siedlung auf einem sterbenden Mond: A settlement on a dying moon is being evacuated. The last transport has a broken jump drive and asks you to bring spare parts to the rendezvous.
Die Siedler laden euch Kisten mit Antrie: The settlers load crates of drive parts aboard and mark the rendezvous.
Ihr fliegt weiter. Hinter euch startet e: You fly on. Behind you, one shuttle after another lifts off.
Am Treffpunkt hängt der Transporter manö: At the rendezvous the transport hangs dead in space. Pirates are already circling it like vultures around a wounded animal.
Ihr schiebt euch zwischen Transporter un: You move between the transport and the cutter.
Ihr werft Frachtkisten ab. Die Piraten s: You jettison cargo crates. The pirates pounce on them while you dock with the transport.
Euer Androide steigt aus, ohne Luft zu b: Your android steps outside, needing no air, and patches the drive in vacuum while the pirates are still aiming. The transport jumps away, you follow.
Die Mechaniker des Transporters brauchen: The transport's mechanics need time to install the parts. The pirates will soon be done searching the crates.
Eure Crew hilft beim Einbau: Your crew helps with the installation
Mit vereinten Kräften läuft der Antrieb: Working together, the drive is running again within minutes.
Ein Kurzschluss verletzt einen Helfer. D: A short circuit injures a helper. The drive runs, but the pirates are coming back.
You undock and face the cutters.
Der Transporter ist sicher. Die Siedler: The transport is safe. The settlers want to thank you as best they can: supplies, spare parts, and a volunteer who wants to come along.
Vorräte und die Freiwillige an Bord nehm: Take the supplies and the volunteer aboard
Die Siedler winken euch nach, bis der Sp: The settlers wave until the jump carries you away.
Die Mechaniker den Rumpf überholen lasse: Let the mechanics overhaul your hull
Die Mechaniker schweißen jede Delle aus,: The mechanics weld out every dent they can find and add spare parts.
Ormok-Bergleute melden einen Einsturz in: Ormok miners report a collapse in their asteroid mine. They need blasting charges from a nearby depot to clear the shaft and offer a share of the ore.
Der Vorarbeiter gibt euch die Koordinate: The foreman gives you the depot's coordinates and his access code.
The mine's radio signal cuts out.
Das Depot ist verlassen, die Sprengladun: The depot is abandoned, the charges still on the shelves. But the access code is out of date, and the automated turret at the gate is armed.
Ein gezielter Schuss, und die Anlage sch: One well-aimed shot and the turret falls silent. You load the crates and fly back to the mine.
Das Außenteam kriecht unter dem Sichtfel: The away team crawls beneath the turret's field of view and fetches the crates.
Die Anlage erwischt jemanden am Bein. Di: The turret catches someone in the leg. The crates make it aboard anyway.
Zurück an der Mine: Die Bergleute sitzen: Back at the mine: the miners are trapped behind tons of rubble. Too much explosive brings the whole shaft down, too little moves nothing.
Das Geröll bricht genau richtig weg. Die: The rubble breaks away just right. The miners crawl cheering into the light and shower you with ore. One of them signs on with you.
Die Decke gibt nach, ein Brocken trifft: The ceiling gives way and a boulder hits your ship. The miners still get free and share their ore.
Unbeeindruckt von Staub und Vakuum schie: Unbothered by dust and vacuum, your Petrani pushes through the rubble and opens a passage. The miners are saved and pay double.
Ein gewaltiger Knall, dann Stille, dann: A huge bang, then silence, then cheering. The way is clear, and the blast has exposed a new ore vein.
Der ganze Stollen bricht ein. Die Bergle: The whole shaft collapses. The miners survive in an air pocket and you have to cut them out painstakingly. The reward is meagre.
Neuer Sektor: offene Aufträge sind verfa: New sector: open jobs have expired
Auftrag verloren: Die Jäger haben das Zi: Job lost: the hunters have taken the target (%s)
Kein Ziel in Reichweite: Der Auftrag ent: No target in range: the job is off
Auftrag: %s · Ziel auf der Karte markier: Job: %s · target marked on the map
Ein Lazarettschiff treibt mit totem Antr: A hospital ship drifts with a dead drive. Forty fever patients are aboard. The doctor asks you to take the worst cases to the clinic. Infection is possible.
Ihr richtet den Frachtraum als Krankenst: You turn the cargo hold into a sick bay. The clinic is expecting you, but the patients won't last long.
Beim Umladen steckt sich jemand aus der: Someone in the crew catches the fever during the transfer. Still, the clinic is expecting you, and the clock is ticking.
Die Ärztin dankt euch und meldet euch de: The doctor thanks you and reports you to the guild. A shipyard will repair you once for free.
Das Wrack ausschlachten, sie sind ohnehi: Strip the wreck, they're lost anyway
Die Ärztin flucht über Funk, während eur: The doctor curses over the radio while your crew cuts parts from the hull. The story spreads quickly.
Die Klinik nimmt eure Kranken auf. Doch: The clinic takes your patients. But the antidote isn't enough for every ship waiting here. The director makes you an offer you won't like.
Ihr bekommt euren Lohn. Draußen warten n: You get your fee. Outside, three more ships wait in vain.
Auf den Lohn verzichten: Gegenmittel für: Waive the fee: antidote for those waiting
Der Leiter schüttelt erst den Kopf, dann: The director shakes his head, then your hand. Word spreads: a guild shipyard wants to repair you for free.
Eine genesene Ärztin anheuern, halber Lo: Hire a recovered doctor, half the fee
Die Ärztin packt ihre Tasche. Sie hat ge: The doctor packs her bag. She's had enough of clinics that have to count costs.
Euer Androide rechnet die Formel nach un: Your android recalculates the formula and rebuilds the synthesis. Enough for everyone, and a fee on top.
In einer Rettungskapsel sitzt ein Pirat: A pirate from Rask's gang sits in an escape pod. He offers the coordinates of a loot cache in exchange for safe passage. The guild pays a bounty for him.
Er grinst: „Klug. Aber beeilt euch, die: He grins: "Smart. But hurry, the gang will clear out the cache soon."
Ihn der Gilde ausliefern: Hand him over to the guild
Er spuckt aus, als die Gildenwachen ihn: He spits as the guild guards lead him away. The bounty is modest, the guild's gratitude is not.
Das Lager ist echt: Kisten voller Ersatz: The cache is real: crates of spare parts in a rock crevice. But two gang cutters are docking right now. The defector whispers: "Drop me off, I'll draw them away." He would hardly survive.
Die Kutter jagen dem Überläufer nach. Ih: The cutters chase the defector. You load in peace, and hear his signal go silent.
Der Überläufer greift zur Waffe: „Dann e: The defector grabs a weapon: "Together, then."
Zwei Kisten greifen und sofort springen: Grab two crates and jump at once
Ihr reißt zwei Kisten an Bord und spring: You haul two crates aboard and jump before the cutters fire.
Ein Kutter erwischt euch beim Ablegen. Z: A cutter catches you as you cast off. You still got two crates.
Ein Mann im teuren Mantel bietet Rohstof: A man in an expensive coat offers scrap now and more on delivery if you take a sealed container to a contact. No questions.
Der Container wird verladen. Er ist schw: The container is loaded. It's heavier than it looks.
Der Mann zuckt mit den Schultern und suc: The man shrugs and looks for the next captain.
Der Kontakt ist ein Piratenkutter. Die E: The contact is a pirate cutter. The recipients want the container, but suddenly they no longer want to pay.
Übergeben und ohne Lohn abziehen: Hand it over and leave unpaid
You hand over the container and leave. At least nobody shoots.
Ihr brecht das Siegel auf, während die P: You break the seal while the pirates watch.
Die Piraten fahren ihre Waffen hoch. Ihr: The pirates power up their weapons. So do you.
Im Container liegen Brandkanonen mit Gil: The container holds incendiary cannons with guild markings, stolen from an arsenal. Soon guild freighters will burn with them. The pirates are getting impatient.
